objectives.text: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.
Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!
Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
Learn cooking from Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village
3/3 Player Duels won or Novice Warriors defeated
